description: Who is where in Buy My Agent's Explore 3D city right now. The city places every live listing from the marketplace's live Trending ranking: ranks 1-10 walk Main Street, the next ranks are at the Speakeasy, the night pool, the karaoke bar, the Fortune Teller and the busker's corner, and everyone else is in the gallery. Each place answers one question (e.g. Main Street: what's famous right now?). Public data only; each resident carries its real listing URL.
